messages:
jo_cs: Quick heads-up — ConvoyAI wants to accelerate their renewal and switch to a 24-month term with a blended rate. They asked to close this week. Current ARR $520k. Procurement requires PO + signed DPA. Need legal, finance, and enablement checks.

sam_sales: Buyer asked for 7% off list if we lock 24 months and include one premium onboarding workshop. Leadership will approve up to 6% without exec sign-off. I shared commercial summary with Ana.

ana_legal: I'll draft the amendment + attach the DPA. If Sales needs 7% we need VP Sales sign-off and a pricing guardrail. Also need to confirm data residency, indemnity bits. Draft ETA EOD.

will_fin: Finance prefers Net30. Vendor code CV-580 required. Monthly invoices okay if PO references CV-580. If discount >6% we need VP Finance sign-off. Also flag: onboarding credit treatment for revenue.

zoe_enable: Enablement can run a 2-hour premium workshop and prep a 30/60/90 success playbook. Need 4 tech contacts and primary use-cases to tailor. We'll include a 3-question feedback pulse after week 2.

tom_se: SE note: recent token-rate spikes on streaming pipeline. Recommend temporary concurrency bump and prefix KV caching during ramp. Adding runbook snippet:

```
worker.concurrency=8
inference.cache.prefix_kv=true
monitor.alert.token_rate>1300 => scale-up
```

jo_cs: Action list: @ana_legal draft amendment + DPA; @will_fin confirm vendor code CV-580 & booking guidance; @sam_sales confirm discount authority; @zoe_enable collect tech contacts; @tom_se add perf notes.

ana_legal: Draft uploaded: https://drive.company/contracts/convoyai_amend_v1. Added clause: "one premium workshop applied as service credit to month 1; discounts >6% require VP Sales approval; pricing guardrail included." PTAL.

sam_sales: Quick update from buyer: CFO will accept 6% + premium workshop. I'll route for final sign-off and prepare DocuSign.

will_fin: Vendor code confirmed CV-580. Finance will treat the workshop as a deferred service credit. VP Finance notified for visibility.

esign_bot: DocuSign envelope created -> https://docusign.company/convoyai_abc (signers: CFO, procurement). Fields: vendor code CV-580, billing cadence per SOW.

jo_cs: Logged renewal in Gainsight and set "early_renewal" tag. Escalate if signature delayed more than 4 business days.

esign_bot: DocuSign envelope status: completed at 6099000026. PO CV-580 attached and matched. Invoice terms: Net30.

zoe_enable: Premium workshop scheduled Apr 26 10:00 PT (2h). Playbook and runbook shared. Survey link will be sent 2 weeks post-workshop.

jo_cs: Closing loop 14 contract signed, PO received, onboarding scheduled. Will post survey results after enablement. Thanks team :tada:
